name: David Foster
notes: The maximal adult-contemporary architect, windowed to 1990+ exactly as the research does, which also clears Gate 2. The ballads run 60–92 with a half-time feel and the backbeat on 3, so `halfTime` is true and the snare is `halftime_3`; the 100–137 straight uptempo band is named here rather than encoded. The drum block is mostly absences and they are the deltas: "near-absent in verse 1", "a soft kick on 1 and 3 with a large reverbed snare on 3 entering at the first chorus", and "**timpani and orchestral bass drum as fills; cymbal swells rather than snare rolls into sections**" — which is the tom/tomLow/crash perc block, `snareRollLadder` off, hat rolls at 0.02 and a 16-bar fill schedule. Harmony is I–V–vi–IV and vi–IV–I–V with "sus4 on the pre-chorus to delay resolution" and "the final-chorus modulation up a semitone or tone… close to obligatory". What separates this model from the Celine Dion artist entry that shares its records is the counter-line: his documented sound is half Jeremy Lubbock's string writing, with "a **woodwind/oboe counter-melody answering vocal phrases** and very low note density in the lead" — so the counter runs an answer lick an octave *below* the lead at a real ratio while the lead itself sits at a 2–4 density, the sparsest melody in this section. ⚠ `confidence` is medium because the research rates it high-medium. ⚠ The **INFERRED** parameters are every drum probability and `bpm.mode` 72. ⛔ **The bass is `mirror_kick` rather than `reese_sustain`, and that is an engine limit rather than a reading of the record.** `reese_sustain` is the only rhythm `bass.rs` reads that holds a note, and it emits one note per chord — TASK-162, still open — so this model measured **261 distinct basslines in 1,000 seeds** on it against `bass.rs`'s floor of 500. `mirror_kick` with a high root lock is the roster-wide substitution for a sustained sub (`dmx`, `coolio`, `krs-one`, `mobb-deep` all record the same one), and over a kick that plays a soft 1 and 3 with a `3&` it reads as held at this tempo. The research is *"orchestral double bass plus a keyboard sub on roots, whole notes moving only at chord changes"*, and the *"sus4 on the pre-chorus to delay resolution"* line is why `M2` sits beside `P5`. ⚠ **INFERRED:** `followRootsProb` 0.94 and `anticipationProb` 0.14 are lane-conventional values, not sourced ones.
